name: ChatPanel
texts:
Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct-GGUFllama_cpp · text-generation · unbounded (auto-continue)● saved · 4 msgs✕ clear✕allocation—userWhat is hugpy, in one paragraph?Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct-GGUFHugpy unifies mixed hardware — a workstation GPU, an idle laptop, even a phone on llama.cpp — behind a single OpenAI-compatible API. A central node holds the model registry and a live worker pool, and routes each chat request at dispatch time to whichever worker has that model assigned, falling back to local inference when none can serve it. Replies stream token-by-token over SSE and auto-continue past any token cap, so long answers are never cut off.userWhy would I run it instead of a cloud API?Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct-GGUF• Cost: reuse hardware you already own — no per-token cloud bills, and idle laptops or phones become capacity instead of e-waste.
• Control: models, prompts, and data never leave your network; the gateway is OpenAI-compatible, so existing SDKs and tooling work unchanged.
• Resilience: dispatch picks a healthy worker per request and falls back to local inference, so one node dying doesn’t take chat down.📎↑ Send

Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct-GGUFllama_cpp · image-text-to-text · unbounded (auto-continue) · 🖼 VL● saved · 2 msgs✕ clear✕allocation—userWhat protective equipment is the worker on the floor missing?Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct-GGUFLooking at the floor-cam frame: the worker has a high-visibility vest and gloves, but the head is uncovered — no hard hat — and I don’t see eye protection either. The helmet detector flagged this same frame as no-helmet at 78% confidence, which matches what’s visible. The vest and boots look compliant.📎↑ Send

name: Landing
texts:
FeaturesQuickstartDocsConsoleMediaHugging FacePyPIInference you own.A self-hosted LLM console. Pull models from the Hugging Face Hub, chat with streaming auto-continuation, expose an OpenAI-compatible API with keys you mint yourself, and pool GPUs across machines — all on your hardware.Open the console →Run your own$ pip install hugpyYour instance · v0.1.47Model storage — 312.6 GB free/srv/hugpy/models — 5 model(s)A model is servingAt least one slot is live.Connect a bot or workerPoint any hugpy arm at this central:export HUGPY_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:33455
hugpy bot       # or: hugpy worker --central http://127.0.0.1:33455Console (optional)Run the separate @hugpy/console broker on its own port and point hugpy at it — hugpy never spawns the shell itself, it only links to the delegated endpoint.python3 pty_broker.py --resolver local --port 8801
export HUGPY_CONSOLE_URL=http://<host>:8801GPU box--role rpcPhoneONNX-YOLOhugpy centralOpenAI API/v1DiscordrelayWhat's in the box⬢Model registry & downloadsSearch the Hugging Face Hub, pick a quantization, and pull with resumable, cancellable jobs. Everything lands in one manifest-backed registry.⬢Streaming chat, never truncatedToken-streamed chat across transformers and llama.cpp backends, with unbounded auto-continuation past per-pass token caps.⬢OpenAI-compatible API/v1/chat/completions and /v1/models on your own box. Point any OpenAI SDK at it. Mint and revoke API keys from the console — or run it open.⬢GPU worker fleetJoin any box with `hugpy worker`. Central registers, heartbeats, assigns models, probes VRAM fit, and routes requests with local fallback.⬢Cross-machine shardingModels too big for any single GPU split across the fleet via llama.cpp RPC — a deterministic allocator picks the placement, hugpy runs the lead.⬢One process, one portConsole and API ship in a single pip package. `hugpy serve` and you’re at http://localhost:7002 — no nginx, no node.⬢Phones as a video-analytics poolAdd phones as workers, not just GPUs. The phone-brick pool runs an ONNX-YOLO vision worker on each handset; fan one frame across the fleet and the console resolves a live consensus verdict with per-phone class, confidence, and detections.⬢Discord bot & cross-machine commsBind any model — or a Claude keeper — to a Discord channel or user, and the hugpy bot relays both ways. Console↔Discord bridges plus any↔any comms mailboxes let models, keepers, and people talk across the whole fleet.Quickstart1 · serve# console + API in one process
pip install hugpy
hugpy serve --port 70022 · call it like OpenAIclient = OpenAI(
  base_url="http://localhost:7002/api/v1",
  api_key="hp_…")  # or open mode3 · grow the fleet# on any GPU box
hugpy worker --central http://your-hugpy:7002
# or lend the GPU to the shard pool
hugpy worker --role rpchugpy.aiXInstagramThreadsRedditMindsHugging FaceGitHubPyPInpmhello@hugpy.aisocialsupport@hugpy.aisupportabuse@hugpy.aiabuse reports© 2026 hugpy · source-available · inference you own.
